incident-bot: pager: elevated 5xx + timeouts observed on api-gateway (us-west-2) starting ~02:14 UTC. Pager: taylor (oncall). Alert: /alerts/2933332100 : Pager routed.

taylor (oncall): On it — gathering traces and kvlogs. Any immediate customer reports? cc @maria (prod)

jamie (eng): Seeing spike in gateway 5xx between 02:14-02:23 UTC. Quick summary: most 502/504 from upstream pool 'model-proxy-pool-a'. Affected routes: /v1/generate and /v1/chat. Putting together sample logs now.

lee (sre): Observed retry amplification too — a lot of gateway retries to the same upstream causing backlog. Attaching short extract:
```
[02:15:12] corrid=0f3b9a path=/v1/generate upstream=model-proxy-12 status=502 upstream_err="connection reset by peer" req_latency=1.24s
[02:15:13] corrid=a2c4e1 path=/v1/chat upstream=model-proxy-11 status=504 upstream_err="read timeout" req_latency=10.01s
[02:15:14] corrid=3b9f11 path=/v1/generate upstream=model-proxy-12 status=502 upstream_err="connection reset by peer" req_latency=1.01s
```

taylor (oncall): Mitigation plan: 1) route a portion of traffic to pool-b, 2) increase gateway upstream timeout to 10s for impacted routes, 3) gather kv log bundle and request traces. Will execute step 1 now (canary).

jamie (eng): Pushed canary route change: `route: pool-a -> pool-b (canary=3 hosts)` — watching.

deploy-bot: route-change: canary applied to 3 hosts — rollout id rc-2933332100-1.

maria (prod): Customer impact check: ~12k failed requests in window (02:14-02:23), ~1.8% of regional traffic. Notified account owners for top customers. Escalating to P1 for tracking.

jamie (eng): Initial hypothesis: pool-a experienced sudden connection resets and backlog, possibly due to a hot batch job or resource saturation in model-proxy leading to upstream resets. Evidence: repeated "connection reset by peer" and FD utilization spikes (more below).

lee (sre): Alternate hypothesis: an auth/token rotation issue produced 401s that translated into 502s at the gateway for certain paths. I'm pulling token rotation logs and nginx error logs for the window.

taylor (oncall): Shared KV log bundle: `s3://redwood-logs/incidents/2933332100/tracebundle.tar.gz` — contains request traces, gateway logs, and model-proxy logs. Tagged sample corrids: 0f3b9a, a2c4e1, 3b9f11.

jamie (eng): sample trace excerpts:
```
corrid=0f3b9a timestamp=02:15:12 route=/v1/generate client_ip=10.2.3.4 upstream=model-proxy-12:5043 status=502 upstream_err="connection reset by peer" retries=2
corrid=a2c4e1 timestamp=02:15:13 route=/v1/chat client_ip=10.3.4.5 upstream=model-proxy-11:5043 status=504 upstream_err="read timeout" retries=4
```

lee (sre): Action item: increase pool-a connection pool size by 20% and restart model-proxy-12 (rolling). Will coordinate with jamie before restart to avoid mass disruption. Also checking kernel tcp_backlog/fd limits.

jamie (eng): Rolling restart scheduled in ~2m. Using runbook command: `kubectl -n model-proxy rollout restart deployment/mp-pool-a -l instance=pool-a` — running now.

deploy-bot: action: rollout restart started for deployment/mp-pool-a (uid r-2933332100).

taylor (oncall): Observed signal: after canary route + rolling restarts, 5xx rate dropped ~70% within 6 minutes. Continuing to monitor for reappearance.

maria (prod): Sent interim customer notice with current mitigation and ETA for next update.

lee (sre): Next diagnostic steps: collect fd/heap stats from model-proxy instances, inspect Nginx upstream timeout configs, evaluate tcp kernel params (tcp_max_syn_backlog, somaxconn, tcp_abort_on_overflow). Also will check for a noisy batch job hitting pool-a around 02:10-02:14.

jamie (eng): Collected FD counts post-incident: model-proxy-12 fd_count=12000 (baseline ~6k). Heap/GC logs attached in the bundle. Looks like FD spike correlates with failure window -> possible leak or unbounded concurrency.

lee (sre): Noted nginx error lines show repeated keepalive timeouts and aborted connections. Attaching snippet:
```
2026-03-17T02:15:10Z error nginx: *3456 upstream prematurely closed connection while reading response header from upstream, client: 10.2.3.4, server: api, request: "POST /v1/generate"
```

taylor (oncall): Owners assigned: jamie -> model-proxy root cause and heap/fd leak analysis; lee -> infra/kernel tuning + nginx config review; maria -> customer comms & impact tracker. I'll keep this thread open for RCA timeline and final notes.

maria (prod): Will prepare post-incident notification once we have a root cause hypothesis and timeline. Please drop final RCA notes here when ready. :white_check_mark:
